about: Answer key for optum diagnose: planted duplicated logic. A: an exact copy (Python). B: a copy with every name and value renamed (Python). C: a copy with small edits (Python). D: a renamed copy (JS). E: near copies (C). Decoys that must not be reported: functions with the same idioms but different logic (order_summary, count_words), tiny look-alike helpers (get_name, get_sku), and a copy in test code.
